_comment: Per-root cap on flake8 E501 (line too long, >100 chars), consumed by scripts/check_line_length.py. E501 is in the global ignore list in .flake8 because of the legacy volume; this ratchet is the compensating control that re-enforces it under a ceiling. The two are designed as a pair — do not relax one without the other. Counts may stay flat or shrink, never grow.
_policy: Initial OSS measurement on develop 17b03f02 (2026-07-27), via flake8 --isolated --select=E501 --max-line-length=100 per root. Totals: api=1, cli=6, config=8, core=280, db=206 (501 overall, matching the aggregate run). black is configured at 100 in pyproject.toml, so every remaining hit is a shape black will not split on its own — long string literals, comment-heavy lines, signatures with long defaults. api/, cli/ and config/ are already near zero and should reach it first. Tightened 2026-08-09: core 280->243, db 206->154 after the orphan history/locking managers were removed. The freed headroom must not be reused. Tightened 2026-09-02: core 243->221 after the dblift namespace move rewrapped long docstring references.
